summary.headline: Carysil Q2 FY27 revenue rose 14.6% YoY to INR275.7 crore, but EBITDA margin fell to 19.4% on freight and raw material costs.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue from operations reached a record second quarter of INR275.7 crore, up 14.6% YoY and 5.2% QoQ, with gross margin up 133 bps to 53.9%. EBITDA rose 9.3% to INR54.1 crore, but margin contracted to 19.4% from 20.3% a year earlier and 21.2% in Q1, which management attributed to higher raw material cost and sea freight. H1 FY27 revenue was INR537.9 crore (up 15%) and PAT INR61.1 crore (up 21.3%). Management maintained FY27 guidance of 15% revenue growth and 18-20% EBITDA margin, and announced a 5% price increase from October; the CFO is also departing.

segments.name: Quartz sinks
segments.commentary: Volume grew about 10% to 217K units; contributed about 54% of revenue.

segments.name: Stainless steel sinks
segments.commentary: Volume grew 8% to 47K units; plant at 91% utilisation, flat in Q2. Sinks overall are 65% of revenue.

segments.name: Faucets and kitchen appliances
segments.commentary: Faucet volume +8%; kitchen appliances revenue +12% per management, though analyst computed about 1% growth; appliance launch slipped to 2027.

segments.name: Surfaces (UK, Carysil Surfaces)
segments.commentary: Revenue fell to GBP5.8 million from GBP7 million; new head to join next month.

segments.name: Carysil Products (UK)
segments.commentary: Record half-year revenue of GBP6.2 million; kitchen sink and faucet replacement market held up.

segments.name: United Granite (US)
segments.commentary: Revenue grew to $5.6 million from $5 million, about 10%+ growth in H1; Q2 growth slowed per management's Q&A.

segments.name: India
segments.commentary: Business grew 30% in H1; India contributed 21% of revenue versus 19% a year ago. Target INR500 crore domestic revenue over next three years.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 15% maintained; management said upside to about 15% is possible if large deals materialise, and it is positioned at the upper side of margin guidance.
FY27 EBITDA margin guidance of 18-20% maintained; management said Q2 margin missed the target but expects improvement as raw material and freight costs cool.
Price increase of 5% taken from October 2026; further raw material inflation to be passed on, with exports largely on FOB basis.
Quartz sink capacity of 250,000 units and stainless steel 150,000 units due by end FY27; faucet and kitchen appliance capacity doubling to 100,000 units also on track for end FY27.

Global launch of nanotechnology-based granite sinks in 2027 starting Europe and US; KBIS Las Vegas launch in early February; first Hafele Australia/NZ orders (25,000-30,000 sinks a year) to be dispatched next month.
Long-term targets reiterated: 1.25 million quartz sinks now, 1.5 million long term; stainless steel 500,000 units.
Kitchen appliance utilisation targeted at 80-85% next year; asset turnover 5-6x capex.
capex_capacity: Granite (quartz) sink plant at 92% utilisation in Q2 FY27; management said it ran above 100% for one month in October on rush orders.
Stainless steel plant at 91% utilisation in Q2 FY27, flat versus prior quarter.
First-phase investment covers 250,000 quartz sinks of molds and machinery; a further 250,000 units would take about four months to add.
Stainless steel 150,000 units and quartz 250,000 units capacity due by end FY27; new press technology (15 and 25 radius) to start in Q4.
Faucet and kitchen appliance capacity doubling to 100,000 units by end FY27; asset-light assembly model.
Only 20 brand stores in India versus 150-200 for peers; INR25-30 crore to be invested in brand stores.
demand_pricing: Management reported strong US inbound inquiries following the US election outcome, with customer visits planned and first stainless steel orders expected by end of 2026.
Amazon US placed its first order (granite sinks); first new stainless steel order expected by end 2026.
Input costs (MMA/PMMA linked to crude) plus sea freight cut margin by about 1.5-2% in Q2; freight and container availability were a challenge but management said only a few containers were slipped.
Price increase of 5% implemented from October 2026.
Management said the UK Surfaces business is soft and the UK kitchen replacement market is holding up better; surfaces hurt by new-build weakness.
India: plan to split sales into e-commerce, B2B and B2C; 5% of distributor discount to be redirected to advertising, with brand ambassador Bobby Deol signed for FY27-28.

qa_highlights.question: Did Carysil lose export revenue due to container shortages and high freight?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said Q2 was a record for exports and India; only a few containers slipped, nothing significant.

qa_highlights.question: Why did Surfaces and kitchen appliances growth stall, and is the 15% growth guidance conservative?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said UK Surfaces is soft, with a new head joining next month; appliance launch slipped past Diwali to 2027. On guidance, it said upside to about 15% is possible if large deals close, but it is not overpromising.

qa_highlights.question: Why did employee and other expenses rise faster than gross profit?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited overlapping employee cost from pre-hiring for capacity expansion (CTO, project heads, engineers) and said employee cost as a percentage of revenue should dilute once capacity is in place by March 2027.

qa_highlights.question: What was the impact of sea freight and raw material inflation on margin, and is there pricing action?
qa_highlights.answer: Combined impact about 1.5-2% on margin; a 5% price increase was taken from last month, so next quarter gets a full-quarter benefit. Exports are on FOB terms, limiting freight exposure.

qa_highlights.question: What is the India expansion strategy and advertising spend plan?
qa_highlights.answer: India to be split into e-commerce, B2B and B2C, with category leadership and KPIs; team expansion across 8-10 core cities. Advertising to rise to about 5% of sales, funded by stopping a 5% extra distributor discount, so margins should be protected.

qa_highlights.question: What are the asset turnover and utilisation targets for the appliances and faucets expansion?
qa_highlights.answer: Asset turnover of 5-6x capex and utilisation of 80-85% targeted for next year.

risks_watch: EBITDA margin missed the 18-20% range in Q2 at 19.4%; management expects improvement only if freight and RM costs keep cooling.
CFO Anand Sharma is resigning; a replacement is said to be shortlisted but not yet named. Management cited personal challenges.
UK Surfaces revenue fell about 25% in Q2 per analyst, with a new head only joining next month.
Kitchen appliances growth was muted in Q2 due to BIS certification and import disruption; BIS deadline for imports is March 2027.
Raw material hedging only 3-4 months forward (MMA/PMMA linked to crude); inventory of raw materials is higher QoQ.
Management has not put a specific number on the US order pipeline; the Amazon and US stainless orders are still early.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on demand and the US order pipeline, but candid that Q2 margins missed target due to freight and raw material costs. Evasive on the CFO departure and on the UK Surfaces decline, which management attributed to a vacancy and soft new-build demand.
key_quotes: Carysil delivered its highest ever second quarter revenue of INR275.7 crores, a growth of 14.6% over last year.
We are maintaining our FY27 guidance of 15% revenue growth with an EBITDA margin of the guidance given, 18% to 20%.
So, India is going to be our growth engine, and if you want to go to INR500 crores, there are a few things we need to do.

adds.what: Quartz sink capacity expansion to 250,000 units/yr (first-phase molds and machinery)
Stainless steel sink capacity addition of 150,000 units/yr

growth.why: FY27 revenue growth of 15% maintained (upside to ~15% if large deals land), backed by 250k quartz and 150k steel sink capacity due by end FY27, a 5% price increase from October, and first Hafele and Amazon US orders; capacity is not yet live and the Q2 margin of 19.4% missed target.

mgmt.note: CFO is departing; discussed on this call, no replacement or growth stance given.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA margin fell to 19.4% from 21.2% in Q1, but a 5% price increase from October gives a full-quarter benefit and management expects freight and RM costs to cool; FY27 guide of 18-20% is held at the upper side.

rows.label: Capacity expansion / commissioning
rows.why: Quartz sinks +250,000 units and stainless steel +150,000 units are under construction with end-FY27 deadline, and faucet/appliance capacity doubling to 100,000 units is also on track; quartz plant at 92% and steel at 91% utilisation.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: Quartz volume +10% to 217K units and steel +8% to 47K units in Q2, with a record export and India quarter, and first Hafele (25,000-30,000 sinks a year) and Amazon US orders being dispatched.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: Quartz plant at 92% utilisation (ran above 100% for a month in October) and steel at 91%, with only 250k quartz units of phase-one capacity coming; management said a further 250k would take about four months to add, and INR25-30 crore is slated for brand stores.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management said revenue upside to about 15% is possible if large deals close, but it is not overpromising; H1 revenue already up 15% to INR537.9 crore.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: Q2 EBITDA margin of 19.4% missed the 18-20% range's midpoint trajectory, raw-material hedging is only 3-4 months forward, and UK Surfaces revenue fell to GBP5.8m from GBP7m; the downgrade depends on freight and RM staying elevated.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Appliance launch slipped past Diwali to 2027 and nanotechnology-based granite sinks are set for global launch in 2027 starting Europe and US; KBIS Las Vegas launch in early February and new press technology (15 and 25 radius) starting Q4 FY27.

rows.label: Hafele Australia/NZ orders
rows.why: First Hafele orders of 25,000-30,000 sinks a year to be dispatched next month, adding a new export channel.

rows.label: US Amazon and stainless steel orders
rows.why: Amazon US placed its first granite sink order and first new stainless steel order is expected by end 2026, though management gave no number on the US pipeline.

rows.label: UK Surfaces recovery under new head
rows.why: Revenue fell to GBP5.8m from GBP7m with a new head joining next month, but management attributes the decline to vacancy and soft new-build demand, with no recovery number given.

tone.note: Management was confident on demand, the US pipeline, capacity timing and FY27 guidance, but candid that Q2 margin missed target on freight and RM; analysts pressed on the CFO exit, UK Surfaces decline, and whether 15% growth guidance is conservative.
